basis: August 27, 2021 is the earliest qualifying disclosure I could verify. Big Lots reported consolidated net sales of $1,457,374,000 for fiscal Q2 2021, below the $1,561,987,150 cutoff. May 28 does not qualify. The proposed −8.5% ceiling assigns an endpoint to qualitative comparable-sales guidance and treats an approximate store contribution as a fixed offset. The earliest date remains unresolved because the May 26 shareholder-meeting remarks and the issuer’s historical investor-event archive could not be recovered.

coverage.detail: The January 13 business update covered fiscal Q4 2020. It announced that day’s ICR fireside chat and said the issuer replay would remain available through January 20.
ICR’s own schedule confirms Big Lots on January 13 from 9:30 to 10:25 a.m. I found the host schedule but could not recover an official recording or transcript from it.
A secondary transcript identifies the opening 7.5% figure as Q4-to-date comparable-sales growth. It provides no primary evidence for a fiscal Q2 2021 consolidated sales ceiling.
The March 5 fiscal Q4 2020 release gave guidance for fiscal Q1 2021 and withheld full-year guidance.
On March 5 management described difficult comparisons in Q2 and Q3. Its quantified total-sales outlook, approximately 80 basis points above comparable-sales growth, applied to Q1.
The proxy identifies a live, virtual May 26 annual meeting with shareholder questions. The notice verifies the event and its host address. It does not reproduce management’s remarks.

The meeting address was inaccessible. The alternate host route https://www.virtualshareholdermeeting.com/vsm/web?pvskey=BIG2021 was also inaccessible. A search for the meeting’s replay, slides and Q&A located the proxy materials but yielded no readable official proceedings.
The 8-K confirms the May 26 meeting and records voting results. Item 2.02 separately identifies May 28 as the public release and call date and characterizes their outlook as initial Q2 guidance.
The May 28 release projected a low-double-digit Q2 comparable-sales decline and around 20% two-year stacked comparable-sales growth. Its explicit $1.00–$1.15 range was for diluted EPS.

Page 8 resolves the May 28 dispute. CFO Jonathan Ramsden estimated a Q2 sales benefit of approximately 150 basis points from net new and remodeled stores. The underlying Q2 comparable-sales decline remained qualitative. The proposed calculation of −10% + 1.5 percentage points = −8.5% is a reviewer’s illustration. Ramsden supplied no explicit numeric upper bound for total sales.

Between May 28 and results, the issuer’s wire archive lists a June 3 fundraiser, June 22 apparel announcement, July 13 executive appointment and August 13 results-scheduling notice. Searches for preliminary results, revised guidance, presentations and conference remarks located no qualifying interim release. The Goldman Sachs conference announcement came September 2.

The historical IR address returned a 404. The attempted archive lookup at https://web.archive.org/web/20210826000000/https://www.biglots.com/corporate/investors/ was inaccessible. The wire index therefore could not be cross-checked against the issuer’s contemporaneous event calendar.

Item 2.02 identifies the investor presentation as an August 27 Q2 results document. The SEC index lists individual slide images. The exhibit wrapper at https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/768835/000076883521000099/bl_2ndqtrxearningsx08262.htm returned a cache miss, and the first slide at https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/768835/000076883521000099/bl_2ndqtrxearningsx08262001.jpg was inaccessible. The deck’s public date is independently established by the 8-K.

The consolidated 13-week table reports $1,457,374,000 for July 31, 2021 versus $1,644,197,000 for August 1, 2020, an 11.4% decline. The prior-year distribution-center sale gain appears below gross margin, so the reported net-sales base needs no adjustment.
Big Lots distributed the actual results at 6:00 a.m. ET on August 27.

publication_date_evidence: The issuer’s August 27 dateline, its 6:00 a.m. ET wire release and Item 2.02 establish when the actuals became public. The earnings transcript and June 1 Form 8-K establish May 28 as the public guidance date. Neither record resolves the missing historical event coverage needed to certify the earliest qualifying date.
